핵심이슈.summary:
## 오늘의 한국 경제 흐름 요약

KDI가 올해 경제성장률 전망을 1.9%에서 2.5%로 대폭 상향 조정하며 경기 회복에 대한 기대감을 높였지만, 동시에 물가 전망도 2.7%로 올려 잡으며 인플레이션 압력을 경고했고, 한국은행에 금리 인상 가능성까지 권고하는 등 **성장과 물가 사이의 딜레마**가 심화되는 모습이다. 실제로 미국 예측시장에서는 올해 인플레이션이 5%에 달할 수 있다는 전망이 나오고 있으며, 마크 잔디를 비롯한 전문가들은 미국 노동시장 약화를 경고하고 있어 글로벌 불확실성도 여전히 높다. 국내 고용 상황도 4월 취업자 증가 폭이 7만 4천 명으로 16개월 만에 최소치를 기록하며 고용률마저 하락 전환했는데, 정부는 추경 집행 본격화를 통해 5월 이후 개선을 기대하고 있다. 한편 MMF와 예금으로의 자금 이동이 늘며 통화량(M2)이 증가하고 채권시장은 좀처럼 온기를 찾지 못하는 가운데, 서울 아파트 전월세 매물 감소와 환율 변동성 확대 등 자산시장 전반의 불안 요인도 잔존하고 있어, **코스피는 하락 출발이 유력하나 조정 시 매수 수요가 하방을 지지할지 주목**된다.

key_headlines.title: Korea Development Institute Raises 2026 Economic Growth Forecast to 2.5%
key_headlines.summary: KDI upgraded its economic growth projection from 1.9% to 2.5%, citing strong semiconductor exports driven by AI demand. The institute also recommended flexible monetary policy including potential rate hikes if inflation persists.

key_headlines.title: April Employment Growth Slows to 74,000, Lowest in 16 Months
key_headlines.summary: Korea's job creation in April increased by only 74,000 workers, marking the weakest growth in 16 months and signaling a turning point in employment rate decline despite economic expansion.

key_headlines.title: U.S. Prediction Markets Signal Potential 5% Inflation Rate This Year
key_headlines.summary: Markets are pricing in the possibility of U.S. inflation reaching 5% in 2026 amid ongoing geopolitical tensions and supply chain disruptions affecting global economies.

key_headlines.title: Foreign Investors Surge into Robotics Stocks as Next Growth Driver
key_headlines.summary: Foreign capital inflows concentrated heavily in robotics sector this month, with robot stocks surging over 30% as investors seek the next major growth engine following semiconductor rally.

key_headlines.title: Bank of Korea Faces Rate Decision Amid Sticky Inflation Pressures
key_headlines.summary: With inflation expectations rising and economic growth improving, the central bank is preparing for rate hikes with market expectations for at least two increases in the current cycle.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economic outlook has improved significantly with the Korea Development Institute raising its 2026 growth forecast to 2.5% from 1.9%, primarily driven by semiconductor exports fueled by AI demand. However, this growth masks concerning labor market weakness, with April job creation hitting a 16-month low of only 74,000 workers despite overall economic expansion. Inflation pressures continue to mount both domestically and internationally, with U.S. inflation potentially reaching 5% and Korean price increases prompting central bank rate increase discussions. The disconnect between asset price rallies and employment weakness raises concerns about inclusive growth.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Korea Development Institute projects 2026 economic growth at 2.5%, up significantly from the previous 1.9% forecast, driven by robust semiconductor demand from artificial intelligence applications. Inflation is expected to rise to 2.7%, prompting KDI to recommend flexible monetary policy including potential rate hikes to anchor inflation expectations. The research institute suggests the need for rate increases if high inflation persists, while noting that expansionary fiscal policy may be less necessary given improved growth prospects. External risks from Middle East tensions have been more than offset by semiconductor sector strength, supporting the upward revision.
sections.Financial Markets: The Korean stock market has surged with the Kospi index rising nearly 90% year-to-date, driven by semiconductor stock rallies including Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. Foreign investors have shifted focus to robotics stocks, showing strong inflows into the sector with prices climbing over 30% this month as the next growth frontier. The won has strengthened against the dollar, testing the 1,500 won level as the central bank signals rate hike intentions, pushing government bond yields upward. International markets show mixed signals with British government bond yields hitting 28-year highs amid political uncertainty and inflation concerns.
sections.Industry & Technology: Robotics has emerged as the hottest sector attracting foreign investor capital, with stocks like LG Electronics and Rainbow Robotics surging over 30% this month as investors seek growth opportunities beyond semiconductors. Silver trading volumes have increased approximately 20-fold to 242.2 billion won in Q1 2026, as semiconductor and EV manufacturers increase demand for the industrial metal used in electronics manufacturing. The battery cathode material market is experiencing significant shifts, with LFP chemistry gaining market share from traditional NCM/NCA cathodes in budget EV segments, reflecting changing battery technology preferences. Government support continues through programs like the manufacturing equipment innovation financing initiative, promoting smart factory adoption among small and medium enterprises.
sections.Real Estate: Apartment supply outlook for May improved substantially by 19.1 points to 80.0 as rising jeonse (lease deposit) prices stimulated housing purchase demand, with government policies enabling lease-encumbered property sales. Government measures allowing sale of properties with jeonse deposits regardless of multiple property ownership resulted in approximately 400 new listings in Seoul within a single day. However, regulatory risks including potential property holding tax increases remain a concern for the housing market. Illegal apartment lottery brokerage activities have increased due to surging property prices, with criminal cases emerging as rising home values attract illegal speculation.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. faces elevated inflation pressure with April CPI rising 3.8%, the highest level since May 2023, dampening expectations for near-term federal rate cuts and complicating the new Fed leadership transition. Washy is expected to assume Fed chairmanship duties starting in mid-June's FOMC meeting, facing the difficult task of balancing inflation concerns against Trump administration pressure for rate cuts. Britain's political uncertainty, with Prime Minister Keir Starmer facing leadership challenges, has triggered government bond selloffs with yields reaching 28-year highs, adding fiscal pressure. Trump administration officials are utilizing semiconductor leverage in trade negotiations with China, seeking market opening and supply chain stability improvements while addressing trade deficits.
sections.AI & Economy: NH Nonghyup Financial Group has launched comprehensive AI governance framework establishment as generative AI and AI agent-based services accelerate across the financial sector amid emerging regulatory requirements. Hyosung Ventures invested in AI-based drug discovery platform ImNewron and beauty solution company AAC Holdings as part of deeptech sector portfolio expansion. UAE investment officials visited Korea to participate in the Korea-UAE AI Infrastructure and Semiconductor Investment Forum, signaling growing international collaboration in AI value chain development. Financial institutions are preparing for anticipated AI guidelines from the Financial Services Commission following January's AI Basic Law implementation.
sections.Others: Nongshim announced plans to increase overseas revenue proportion to 60% by 2030, establishing a Busan export-dedicated factory and expanding distribution in major markets including the US, Japan, and China. Duobak achieved 15.5% revenue growth in Q1 2026 reaching 6.26 billion won through global market expansion and gaming chair product line enhancement across Northern Europe markets. The Korean Management Development Institute launched its 63rd manufacturing innovation equipment subsidy program, offering zero-interest, non-guaranteed financing for SMEs adopting intelligent production systems and carbon reduction equipment. The Financial Investment Association engaged with Luxembourg's ambassador to explore European market expansion opportunities and develop global business initiatives in digital asset and asset management sectors.
